lines.text: Job asks his friends to listen carefully, bear with him, and put their hand over their mouth.
Job asks why the wicked live on, grow old and increase in power, with homes safe from fear.
The children of the wicked skip about singing, and the wicked go down to Sheol in terror.
Job asks whether the wicked are like grass and chaff.
Job asks his friends whether they have asked travelers on the roads, and calls their answers full of falsehood.
